name: twitter-one-click-block
description: Block users on Twitter in one click instead of 3

scripts.zip: node -e 'const manifest = require("./manifest.json"); const { execSync } = require("child_process"); const version = manifest.version; execSync(`zip -r one-click-blocker-${version}.zip manifest.json options.html options.js account-data.js index.js settings.js service-worker.js images/`, { stdio: "inherit" });'
